output.summary: The deterministic verdict is NO_POLICY: the window_policy_summary reports business_verdict NO_POLICY and resource_verdict NO_POLICY, and the fact policy_verdict is NO_POLICY. The run is VALID and analysis coverage is COMPLETE. Metrics are descriptive only: 720 samples with 0 errors; latency p50 150 ms, p95 300 ms, p99 300 ms, max 300 ms, identical in overall and transaction scopes. A system resource series (unit synthetic_unit) has 36 observed cells (mean 35, min 10, max 60, std ~17.3, slope_per_second ~0.27). The only correlation pair is BELOW_EFFECT (raw rho 1 at best_lag 0 over 36 paired cells; reasons LOAD_DELTA_BELOW_MINIMUM and CONTROL_CONTEXT_MISSING; uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED), and the headline correlation selection is NOT_SELECTED with MATERIALITY_NOT_MET. No anomaly episodes were reported (anomalies_tested 0). Because no applicable rule was evaluated, the window yields no PASS/FAIL; a healthy-looking profile does not turn NO_POLICY into PASS. Advice focuses on configuring an applicable policy to obtain a real verdict, verifying clock alignment before any temporal reading, generating a larger load delta (and a control series) so materiality can be evaluated, and inspecting raw series before making stability or capacity claims.
